UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated adventurer preferences, baseline mileage, integration flags, partner party link, seasonal theme, and streak.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

weeklyBaselineMiles.description: Starting weekly mileage baseline in miles (1.0-150.0).

corosConnected.description: Whether COROS OAuth or GPX sync is enabled.

garminConnected.description: Optional: whether Garmin Connect sync is enabled.

stravaConnected.description: Optional: whether Strava sync is enabled.

pathboundConnected.description: Optional: whether Pathbound companion link is enabled.

healthConnectAutoExport.description: Whether new workouts auto-export to Health Connect.

accountRole.description: Optional: whether signed in as Primary or Partner adventurer.

partnerPartyCode.description: Optional: shared 6-16 char Tavern Party invite code linking both partners.

ActivityRecord.title: ActivityRecord
ActivityRecord.description: A recorded or imported run, trail hike, or equestrian endurance ride with pace, elevation, splits, coaching tip, voice note transcript, gear link, and GPS route.

activityType.description: Run, trail hike, or equestrian ride.

avgPaceSecPerMile.description: Average pace in seconds per mile (120-7200).

startedAtEpochMs.description: Activity start time in epoch milliseconds.

externalId.description: Optional deduplication ID from external fitness services.

gearId.description: Optional shoe or equestrian saddle ID (1-64 chars).

voiceTranscript.description: Optional transcribed audio trail note (0-1000 chars).

aiCoachingSummary.description: Optional encouraging AI pace insight (0-1200 chars).

routePoints.description: Optional bounded list (<=250) of encoded lat,lon,ele strings.

splitPacesSec.description: Optional bounded list (<=100) of per-mile split seconds.

WeeklyChallenge.title: WeeklyChallenge
WeeklyChallenge.description: Progressive weekly mileage quest derived from past performance.

MilestoneRecord.title: MilestoneRecord
MilestoneRecord.description: Shareable D&D-themed achievement badge unlocked by the adventurer.

TavernParty.title: TavernParty
TavernParty.description: Shared 2-member party linking Primary and Partner Google accounts for combined mileage and encouragement.

partyCode.description: Unique 6-16 char alphanumeric invite code matching document ID.

creatorUid.description: UID of the adventurer who created the party.

memberUids.description: 1 to 2 Firebase Auth UIDs belonging to this partner party.

/users/{userId}.description: User-scoped adventurer profile, partner role, seasonal theme, and integration preferences.

/users/{userId}/activities/{activityId}.description: User-scoped runs, hikes, and equestrian endurance rides.

/parties/{partyId}.description: Shared 2-person Tavern Party linking primary and partner accounts via invite code.
